title: Binance Recovers Most Funds After Historic $6.3 Billion Cyber Theft
subtitle: The world's largest cryptocurrency exchange promises to pay back all users after a record-breaking attack linked to North Korean hackers.

summary.en: Binance, the world's largest cryptocurrency exchange, has recovered 90 percent of the $6.3 billion stolen in a recent cyber attack. The company has promised to cover all losses for its customers. Experts believe the attack was carried out by a sophisticated North Korean military unit. While the company works to restore full services, the incident has raised new questions about the security of digital asset platforms. The exchange plans to reopen withdrawal services soon.
summary.zh: 全球最大的加密貨幣交易所幣安，已追回近期網路攻擊中遭竊的六十三億美元資金中的九成。該公司承諾將賠償客戶所有損失。專家認為這場攻擊是由精密的北韓軍事單位所為。儘管該公司正致力於恢復全面服務，但此事件已引發對數位資產平台安全性的新質疑。該交易所計畫於近期重新開放提款服務。

paragraphs.en: In a major update following the largest cyber heist in history, Binance announced that it has successfully recovered 90 percent of the $6.3 billion stolen from its platform. The company, which is the world's largest cryptocurrency exchange, stated that it is working to replace the remaining 10 percent of the funds. This massive theft, which occurred late last week, has sent shockwaves through the digital finance industry.
paragraphs.zh: 在史上最大規模的網路竊案發生後，幣安（Binance）發布重大更新，宣布已成功追回平台遭竊的六十三億美元中的九成資金。這家全球最大的加密貨幣交易所表示，正致力於補足剩餘的一成款項。這起發生於上週後期的巨額竊案，已對數位金融產業造成巨大衝擊。

paragraphs.en: According to The Verge, the exchange is committed to covering the full financial impact for all affected customers. While most of the stolen digital assets have been restored, the remaining 10 percent consists of tokens that are harder to trade. Binance noted that these assets may take more time to acquire, but the company remains firm in its promise to make all users whole. As part of its recovery process, the platform had temporarily paused withdrawals, but it expects to resume these services by Sunday.
paragraphs.zh: 根據科技媒體「邊緣」（The Verge）報導，該交易所承諾將全額賠償所有受影響客戶的財務損失。雖然大部分遭竊的數位資產已找回，但剩餘的一成資金涉及較難交易的代幣。幣安指出，取得這些資產可能需要更多時間，但公司仍堅定承諾會讓所有用戶獲得全額補償。作為復原程序的一部分，該平台曾暫時停止提款服務，預計將於週日恢復運作。

paragraphs.en: NPR News reports that the attack took place over a short period of only 20 minutes, allowing hackers to access investor accounts and move billions of dollars at the speed of the internet. Ari Redbord, a policy expert at the research firm TRM Labs, described the event as the largest bank robbery in human history. TRM Labs has been working closely with Binance to trace the stolen money and freeze approximately $3 billion of the assets, preventing the hackers from fully controlling the stolen funds.
paragraphs.zh: 美國國家公共廣播電台（NPR News）報導，這場攻擊在短短二十分鐘內發生，駭客得以進入投資人帳戶，並以網路速度轉移數十億美元。研究機構 TRM Labs 的政策專家瑞德博德（Ari Redbord）形容此事件為人類歷史上最大規模的銀行搶案。TRM Labs 一直與幣安密切合作，追蹤遭竊資金並凍結約三十億美元的資產，防止駭客完全掌控這些贓款。

paragraphs.en: Security experts and researchers have pointed to a North Korean military hacking unit known as TraderTraitor as the likely group behind the attack. NPR News noted that this unit is well-known for its high level of skill and has been linked to previous large-scale thefts, including a $1.5 billion heist from the exchange Bybit last year. Experts believe that the money stolen in these attacks is often used by the North Korean government to support weapons development and other activities that threaten regional stability.
paragraphs.zh: 資安專家與研究人員指出，一個名為「交易叛徒」（TraderTraitor）的北韓軍事駭客組織極有可能是幕後黑手。NPR News 指出，該組織以高超技術聞名，且與過去多起大規模竊案有關，包括去年從 Bybit 交易所竊取的十五億美元。專家認為，這些攻擊中竊取的資金，通常被北韓政府用於支持武器研發及其他威脅區域穩定的活動。

paragraphs.en: This incident has brought renewed attention to the safety of cryptocurrency exchanges. These platforms act like traditional stock exchanges, such as the New York Stock Exchange, but for digital assets like Bitcoin. Many investors choose to leave their digital money on these platforms for safekeeping. However, critics argue that this system makes exchanges very attractive targets for criminals. Because users trust these companies to hold their assets, a single security failure can lead to massive losses for thousands of people.
paragraphs.zh: 此事件讓大眾重新關注加密貨幣交易所的安全性。這些平台的功能類似於紐約證券交易所（New York Stock Exchange）等傳統證券交易所，只是交易標的為比特幣（Bitcoin）等數位資產。許多投資人選擇將數位貨幣留在平台上保管，然而批評者認為，這種機制使交易所成為犯罪分子極具吸引力的目標。由於用戶信任這些公司代管資產，單一的安全漏洞就可能導致數千人蒙受巨大損失。

paragraphs.en: While it is still too early to know exactly how the hackers bypassed the security systems, the event highlights the growing sophistication of state-sponsored cyber groups. For now, Binance is focusing on its promise to demonstrate measurable progress through transparent reporting and concrete actions. The company has stated that it will continue to provide updates as it works to reopen all services for its global user base.
paragraphs.zh: 雖然目前斷定駭客如何繞過安全系統仍言之過早，但此事件凸顯了國家級駭客組織日益精密的技術。目前，幣安正專注於透過透明的報告與具體行動，展現其兌現承諾的實質進展。該公司表示，在努力恢復全球用戶所有服務的同時，將持續提供最新消息。

paragraphs.en: As the industry moves forward, the focus will likely shift toward how exchanges can better protect themselves against such high-level threats. The scale of this heist serves as a warning for both investors and companies in the digital finance sector. For many, the recovery of the funds is a positive sign, but the event remains a stark reminder of the risks involved in the modern digital economy.
paragraphs.zh: 隨著產業持續發展，焦點可能會轉向交易所如何提升防禦能力，以抵禦此類高層級威脅。此次竊案的規模對數位金融領域的投資人與企業皆是一項警訊。對許多人而言，資金得以追回是個正面跡象，但此事件仍嚴正提醒了現代數位經濟中潛藏的風險。

keyTerms.definitionEn: To compensate someone fully for their financial losses so they are in the same position as before the loss.
keyTerms.definitionZh: 賠償某人所有的損失，使其恢復到受損前的財務狀況。
keyTerms.noteZh: 這是一個常見的金融慣用語，容易誤解為「讓使用者變得完整」。文中：Binance noted that these assets may take more time to acquire, but the company remains firm in its promise to make all users whole.

keyTerms.definitionEn: A feeling of widespread alarm or disturbance caused by a sudden, shocking event.
keyTerms.definitionZh: （因突發事件引起的）強烈震驚或動盪。
keyTerms.noteZh: 原意指物理上的「衝擊波」，這裡用來比喻金融市場的恐慌與動盪。文中：This massive theft, which occurred late last week, has sent shockwaves through the digital finance industry.

keyTerms.definitionEn: Clear, obvious, and often unpleasant or severe.
keyTerms.definitionZh: 明顯的、嚴峻的、赤裸裸的。
keyTerms.noteZh: 容易被誤認為「僵硬的」，但在這裡用來強調提醒的嚴肅性。文中：For many, the recovery of the funds is a positive sign, but the event remains a stark reminder of the risks involved in the modern digital economy.

quiz.question: What is the current status of the funds stolen from Binance?

options.A: All stolen funds have been fully recovered and returned to user accounts.
options.B: The majority of funds have been recovered, but 10 percent remain outstanding.
options.C: Binance has abandoned the search for the remaining 10 percent of stolen assets.
options.D: Only 10 percent of the total stolen money has been successfully recovered so far.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。根據文章第一段與第二段，Binance 已經找回了 90% 的被盜資金，剩下的 10% 雖然較難取得，但公司承諾會補足。選項 A 錯誤，因為目前尚未完全找回；選項 C 錯誤，因為公司承諾會讓所有用戶拿回資金；選項 D 則剛好將比例弄反了。

quiz.question: Based on the information provided, why might investors be concerned about keeping their assets on cryptocurrency exchanges?

options.A: Exchanges are legally required to share user data with foreign governments.
options.B: Digital assets are inherently worthless compared to traditional stock exchange investments.
options.C: The concentration of assets on these platforms makes them high-value targets for sophisticated cybercriminals.
options.D: Exchanges have publicly stated that they cannot guarantee the safety of user funds during cyberattacks.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。根據文章第五段，作者提到許多投資人將數位貨幣存放在交易所，但這使得交易所成為犯罪分子的誘人目標，單一安全漏洞即可能導致大量損失。選項 A 文章未提及；選項 B 過度推論且非文章核心；選項 D 與 Binance 承諾保障用戶權益的立場不符。

quiz.question: In the phrase 'make all users whole,' what does the word 'whole' mean as used in the context of the second paragraph?

options.A: To restore someone to their original financial position before a loss occurred.
options.B: To ensure that all users remain physically present and safe during the crisis.
options.C: To provide users with a complete and comprehensive update on the investigation.
options.D: To increase the total value of the assets held by the users significantly.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 A。在金融語境中，「make someone whole」意指賠償損失，使受害者恢復到受損前的財務狀態。選項 B 錯誤，此詞與人身安全無關；選項 C 雖文章有提到會提供更新，但這不是此片語的定義；選項 D 錯誤，這並非單純的資產增值，而是補償損失。

quiz.question: What is the primary message of the article regarding the recent Binance cyber heist?

options.A: The heist was a minor technical glitch that Binance resolved within 20 minutes.
options.B: North Korean hackers are the only group capable of stealing from major exchanges.
options.C: The incident highlights both the vulnerability of digital finance platforms and the ongoing challenges of security.
options.D: Binance is now the most secure cryptocurrency exchange in the world due to its recovery efforts.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。全文從駭客攻擊事件出發，討論了恢復過程、安全風險、犯罪集團的複雜性以及對數位金融產業的警示，綜合反映了數位資產平台面臨的風險與挑戰。選項 A 嚴重低估事件規模；選項 B 過度簡化駭客威脅；選項 D 文章並未宣稱 Binance 是最安全的，僅強調其應對措施。
